scope: Two separate push-triggered Actions runs, one synthetic checkpoint, manual operator-mediated anchor via connector after successful A, no active Cortex or production. No private key exported. A uses fixed logical time NOW; B uses NOW+20. Registry revision 2 revokes old key at NOW+10 and retains new key. Old receipt verified historically under revision 1, old key now revoked. Unseen documents signed in A for use B. No live source or time claim.
A: Create old/new ephemeral Ed25519 keys, two registry revisions, stage one old-key receipt with nonce 1 and signed true arithmetic. Export canonical JSON checkpoint with version 1, zero parent hash, source run metadata, registry history, public PEMs, original envelope, and three presigned B envelopes (rotated-key replay nonce 1, symbolic nonce 2, false arithmetic nonce 3). Log checkpoint SHA256 and source metadata; upload exact file. Fresh runner B must not receive private keys.
B: Download exact A artifact using pinned ID and independently recorded archive SHA256, check canonical JSON checkpoint SHA256, source run ID/attempt/commit, version, parent and registry revision against separately committed operator anchor. Restore SQLite via historical signature verification of receipt; verify exact snapshot. Reject old-key receipt under revocation, rotated-key reuse nonce 1, altered envelope (no state change), stale CAS, then accept symbolic and false arithmetic as receipts only. Export linked successor checkpoint and Cortex staging rows with knowledge_admitted=false; no writes to active Cortex. Validate older version, equal-version altered payload, wrong parent, registry rollback, artifact metadata substitution and missing anchor against frozen anchor. No claims beyond relative-to-anchor rollback detection. Manual anchor trusted, not autonomous or independent witness.
gate: Run A successful, artifact exact, then run B separate ID, complete all controls; preserve A and B evidence. No automatic retries. If metadata unavailable HOLD.
